document.title: fix(ui): copy hit-test result before releasing snapshot lock
document.summary: `instance_hit_test` returns an owned `strdup` copy of the hit id, and the mouse and touch pollers free it at the end of each frame.
document.why: [`instance_hit_test` returned a pointer into a snapshot the JS thread can free](source:s1) while the input code still used it.

sources.title: Use-after-free: instance_hit_test returns pointer into a snapshot that can be freed
sources.gist: Return an owned copy of the hit id and free it in input code; add an ASan harness.

lookFor: [#39](source:s1) asks for a CTest harness that swaps snapshots while hit-testing under ASan; the PR adds none, because without ASan (#53) such a test cannot catch the use-after-free deterministically.

groups.title: Hit test returns an owned id
groups.why: The copy must happen while `snapshot_mutex` is held, because `instance_tree_swap` frees the old snapshot right after unlocking.
groups.summary: `instance_hit_test` in `instance_tree.c` now `strdup`s the hit id inside the lock, matching `instance_scroll_at`, and the header changes the return type to `char *`.

groups.title: Input pollers free the hit id
groups.why: Callers now own the returned string.
groups.summary: `poll_mouse_input` and `poll_touch_input` hold `top_id` as `char *` and free it on their single exit path at the end of the function.
lookFor: Perf: every mouse poll now allocates and frees one string per frame when the cursor is over an element; touch polls allocate only while a finger is down.

commits.subject: fix(ui): copy hit-test result before releasing snapshot lock
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
instance_hit_test returned a pointer into the front snapshot arena after
unlocking snapshot_mutex, so input code could read it after the JS thread
swapped and freed that snapshot. Return a strdup'd id and free it in
poll_mouse_input/poll_touch_input.

Fixes #39
